auditor: gpt-5.6-sol blind (fresh codex exec, read-only scratch workdir, r6)

probe_detail.name: Reveal forces a rereading of the setup
Ends on a short final line
Nothing in the text is removable

final.name: Self-undermining irony
final.audit_justification: A precise contradiction between attitude and behavior is a substantive comic mechanism and evidence of crafted irony.

final.name: Source-transfer residue
final.audit_justification: Transfer residue primarily reveals provenance, though circulation through an established source may also select jokes with genuine comic strength.

final.name: Taboo and shock-content reliance
final.audit_justification: This measures the presence of taboo subject matter rather than how effectively that material produces humor.
final.upstream_parent: circulation through shock and transgression culture

final.name: Orthographic irregularity
final.audit_justification: Orthographic habits are surface fingerprints, though the care or writing competence behind them may also affect genuine joke quality.

final.name: Taboo-register intensity
final.audit_justification: The amount and explicitness of taboo content are topic and register markers rather than evaluations of comic execution.
final.upstream_parent: audience taboo tolerance and social-climate effects

final.name: Community self-satire with crafted payoff
final.audit_justification: Although community reference is topical, the criterion requires that it be converted into a constructed comic payoff.

final.name: Length and elaboration
final.audit_justification: Text bulk, lineation, and padding measured without regard to function are incidental presentation features.

final.name: Recognizable internet format, twisted
final.audit_justification: Precise imitation whose twist exploits the imitated format is a substantive mechanism of the joke.

final.name: Absurd concrete specificity
final.audit_justification: Concrete details that deliberately intensify incongruity are evidence of effective comic construction.

final.name: Freshness within a familiar form
final.audit_justification: A specific and non-obvious transformation of a familiar template directly measures originality and comic craft.

final.name: Premise-punchline fit
final.audit_justification: The functional connection between setup and punchline is central to whether the joke coheres and lands.

final.name: Headline-dependence of the comic engine
final.audit_justification: Dependence on current events is a temporal and subject-matter marker rather than an evaluation of how funny the topical joke is.
final.arbiter_reason: The instruction directly measures dependence on current events and news-specific markers, not the forum audience’s judgment of comedic quality. Topical recognition can nevertheless contribute genuinely to humor, so this nuisance may also produce real quality.

final.name: Phonetic phrase transformation
final.audit_justification: A clear sound-alike or resegmentation is a substantive wordplay mechanism.

final.name: Repost-chain disclosure
final.audit_justification: Explicit repost disclosure is provenance furniture, though prior circulation may have selected material with genuine audience-tested appeal.

final.name: Delayed frame reversal
final.audit_justification: Establishing and then sharply reversing a plausible frame is a core comic construction.

final.name: Stock-punchline position in the retelling chain
final.audit_justification: Canonical retelling status measures provenance and familiarity, though long-lived jokes may have circulated partly because of genuine comic merit.
final.upstream_parent: position in the retelling chain of a previously circulated joke (nth re-post)

final.name: Deadpan literal answer where wit expected
final.audit_justification: Deliberately frustrating an expectation of wit with a literal answer is a recognizable substantive comic mechanism.

final.name: Delivery-template commitment
final.audit_justification: The mere presence of a stock delivery shell is a format marker and does not assess its execution.

final.name: Reception-management furniture: vote appeals, repost apologies
final.audit_justification: Vote appeals and repost apologies are audience-management furniture, though they can reflect author experience that also plausibly affects actual joke quality.

final.name: Reference transformed into mechanism
final.audit_justification: Actively transforming a reference into the punchline measures creative use of source material rather than mere topic presence.

final.name: Compression and payoff immediacy
final.audit_justification: Economy, functional wording, and an immediately intelligible payoff directly bear on comic delivery.

final.name: Constructed shock handling
final.audit_justification: This distinguishes constructed comic use of provocative material from provocation unsupported by a mechanism.

final.name: Conversational voice authenticity
final.audit_justification: Distinctive, convincing voice and rhythm are substantive aspects of comic delivery, despite their possible correlation with authorship style.

final.name: Surface readability
final.audit_justification: Readability is assessed here by whether wording and presentation let readers apprehend the comic mechanism rather than by surface correctness alone.

final.name: Era-coded forum idiom
final.audit_justification: Era-specific vocabulary, events, slogans, and platform references are temporal and venue fingerprints.
